name: Arcane AOE
description: Mystical violet area of effect: a glowing rune circle, a white-violet orb with a vertical energy beam, gyroscopic orbit rings, levitating crystal shards and low arcane mist.

metadata.analysis: cast: rune circle ignites and energy streaks gather inward | build: orbit rings spiral out of the centre, orb emerges and the beam opens | ascend: crystal shards burst from the ground and levitate, power peaks | sustain: gyroscopic rings spin with sparkle nodes, beam pulses, mist rolls | fade: energy disperses outward, rings widen, shards fall
